headline: SGX to launch crypto perpetual futures, only for US institutional investors
summary: The Singapore Exchange is preparing to offer crypto perpetual futures only to US institutional investors. It would be the first major traditional exchange to bring the popular crypto product into mainstream markets.
why: The Singapore Exchange is a major Asian exchange operator, and listing crypto derivatives brings digital asset products into regulated traditional market infrastructure.

impacts.name: Singapore Exchange
impacts.why: The exchange plans to add crypto perpetual futures for a specific investor group.
